svg.title: V3X: the engine-level modding platform for Victoria 3
svg.desc: Banner: V3X emblem and title, the engine-level modding platform. Build mods that run inside Victoria 3's engine: hook functions safely, read live data, add commands. Loader, API v4, SDK, plugins. Game 1.15.1, Windows x64, single player, unofficial.
svg.text: Build mods that run inside Victoria 3's engine:
hook functions safely, read live data, add commands.
